title: 1 Variant, 18 New Pieces
summary: Tony plays 'Meta Chess', a web game where each piece slot can be swapped ('Edit My Board') for one of ~18 variant pieces, plus immovable Rocks in the central rows. Game 1 vs the 1600 bot 'Sarah' with an unexplained mixed army ends in a cheap draw by repetition (~5:08). He then drafts his own army (Voids/Phantom of the Abyss for rooks, Medusas, etc.) and after several games finally checkmates a bot with K+Q vs K (~21:44).
rules: Standard 8x8 chess structure; each player drafts which variant piece fills each slot; king cannot be changed.
Pawn slot options: Scout (moves diagonally across board, captures moving backwards), Jester, Rock.
Rook slot: Void / 'Phantom of the Abyss' — spawns in the void, moves horizontally, can pass through Rocks and capture beyond them; seemed uncapturable while in the void.
Sumo 'Immovable Mountain': captures within a 3x2 rectangle in front or one square directly behind; may castle (still moves normally despite the name).
Dragonfly (knight slot): captures like a knight moving forward and one square diagonally backwards.
Medusa, 'the petrifying queen': turns enemies 3 tiles in front into stone, captures up to 2 squares ahead, moves 1 square in any direction.
Sniper: attacks only the farthest square on each diagonal, jumping all pieces; moves up to 2 left/right/back and 1 forward.
Queen slot options: Pegasus, Empress (rook+knight), Kraken (moves/captures up to 2 squares any direction; leaves marks of its last 5 moves it can return to).
Rock: cannot move or be captured, placed in the center rows (breakable in special cases).
Pawns promote on the last rank; draws by repetition exist.
win_condition: Checkmate a Meta Chess bot (goal: win one game).
